headline: Your website is the first hearing. *Win it.*
sub: SiteBlitz builds authoritative law firm websites — dedicated practice-area pages, discreet consultation paths and SEO that compounds. Designed, engineered and live in as little as 48 hours.

painPoints.title: Templates that whisper, not argue
painPoints.text: Most law firm sites look like they were built in 2012 and forgotten. A prospective client comparing three firms decides who looks credible in seconds — and dated design reads as dated practice.

painPoints.title: No clear path to a consultation
painPoints.text: A phone number buried in the footer is not a consultation path. Someone researching a sensitive matter at 11pm needs a discreet way to reach you — a private form, WhatsApp, anything but a cold call in office hours.

painPoints.title: Every practice area crammed onto one page
painPoints.text: When family law, property disputes and corporate advisory share a single paragraph, Google ranks you for none of them. And a client with one specific problem can't tell whether you solve it.

mustHaves.title: Authority at first glance
mustHaves.text: Restrained design, clear typography, credentials and court experience front and centre. No stock gavels. The site should carry itself the way your firm does.

mustHaves.title: A page per practice area
mustHaves.text: Each practice area gets its own server-rendered page with its own keywords and structured data. That's how a firm ranks for 'property lawyer in Delhi' instead of only its own name.

mustHaves.title: Discreet consultation paths
mustHaves.text: Private enquiry forms, WhatsApp integration and lead capture that works after hours. First contact on a legal matter should feel confidential — because it is.

mustHaves.title: SEO that compounds
mustHaves.text: Server-rendered pages, legal-service structured data and 90+ Lighthouse targets on every build. Search visibility is the cheapest client acquisition a firm will ever own.

mustHaves.title: Proof, not promises
mustHaves.text: A first-party analytics dashboard shows which practice areas draw enquiries, where visitors come from and where they drop off. We publish our own live numbers at /proof — your site gets held to the same standard.

faqs.q: How fast can our firm's website go live?
faqs.a: A one-page site on the Launch plan (₹7,999 / $99) goes live in 48 hours. Most firms choose Growth (₹14,999 / $189): up to 5 pages — ideal for practice areas — delivered in 4 days, analytics dashboard included.

Enquiry forms deliver straight to your firm, analytics stay first-party, and we never publish client names, matters or testimonials without written approval. Discretion is a design requirement, not an afterthought.

faqs.q: Have you built for law firms before?
faqs.a: We publish client work only with the client's permission and numbers we can back up, so there is no law-firm case study on this site yet. What you can judge today is how we build: this site's own live analytics and real-user Core Web Vitals are public at /proof.

cta: Book your build. Your next client is already searching.
